events.evidence: In the biggest bank failure in American history, the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation seizes Washington Mutual and sells most of the bank to JPMorgan Chase
Japan and Hong Kong detect melamine in Chinese food products including breakfast cereals and crackers
German commandos storm a KLM airliner at Cologne-Bonn Airport and arrest two men suspected of planning to carry out a terrorist attack

label.note: Washington Mutual failure and weak financial confidence dominate; terror arrest and food scandal add stress.
